latest_release.name: v5.1.4
latest_release.body:
## 5.1.4

[Full diff since 5.1.3](https://github.com/liketrek/TREK/compare/v5.1.3...v5.1.4)

This release keeps Vacay's public holidays working past January 2027, when the old holiday API ends, and fixes AirTrail sending its stored API key to a newly entered address. Update before February; the apps for iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Android are still in a closed test, and you can join: 👉 **[Sign up at liketrek.com/app-test](https://liketrek.com/app-test)**.

### Added

- Bakeries and groceries on the map and along a hike ([#3026](https://github.com/liketrek/TREK/issues/3026)). The map's place search and a tour's stops along the route also find bakeries and supermarkets, for restocking on a multi-day hike.
- Settings say what they reach. On a phone and in the app the sections stand under "Your account", which follows you to every device, and "This device".
- An install guide for TrueNAS SCALE in the wiki ([#3060](https://github.com/liketrek/TREK/issues/3060)), from the TrueNAS Community catalog, including updates.

### Fixed

**Security**

- AirTrail kept its API key for a new address. Saving the settings with another host and the key field left as it was kept the stored key, and the next sync sent it to that host. A new host now needs its own key; a path change on the same host keeps it. Thanks to Jacob-Lasky for the report ([GHSA-mwf5-5px8-c9h5](https://github.com/liketrek/TREK/security/advisories/GHSA-mwf5-5px8-c9h5)).

**Vacay and Atlas**

- Public holidays in Vacay would have stopped working in February ([#3057](https://github.com/liketrek/TREK/issues/3057)). The holiday provider ends its v3 API on 31 January 2027; Vacay now uses Nager.Holidays v4. Holiday names now show in English, because v4 no longer returns local names.
- Ireland showed four provinces in the Atlas ([#2922](https://github.com/liketrek/TREK/issues/2922)). It now shows Ireland's 26 counties, from Tailte Éireann's statutory boundaries; places marked before keep their marks.
- The Atlas put Nice and Menton in Italy ([#3048](https://github.com/liketrek/TREK/issues/3048), [#3049](https://github.com/liketrek/TREK/issues/3049)). A coastal point that no country polygon contains went to the country with the smallest bounding box; it now goes to the nearest border.

**Planner and bookings**

- A transport or booking form lost what was typed ([#3069](https://github.com/liketrek/TREK/issues/3069)). Every re-read of the trip, which a WebSocket reconnect behind a proxy brings every few seconds, filled the open form in again; it now resets only when another entry is opened.
- A flight without airports lost its day and times on saving ([#3070](https://github.com/liketrek/TREK/issues/3070)). Like a train without stations, it now takes them from the form's rows.
- Places could not be reordered by drag and drop in Firefox ([#3041](https://github.com/liketrek/TREK/issues/3041)). Firefox took the first mouse move of a drag as its end; the day list also no longer replays its fade-in after a drop.
- Blank days while swiping quickly through a trip on iOS ([#3067](https://github.com/liketrek/TREK/issues/3067)). The pager now also draws the days around the one a swipe is heading for.
- A recorded Dawarich route was barely visible on past trips. It is now drawn in full colour, wider and with longer dashes, on both map engines.

**Sign-in**

- An SSO account was locked out after the provider changed its subject ([#3065](https://github.com/liketrek/TREK/issues/3065)). The admin user dialog now has "Remove SSO link", and the next SSO sign-in links the account again.

**Assistant**

- The assistant failed on Azure AI Foundry reasoning models ([#3043](https://github.com/liketrek/TREK/issues/3043)). These deployments refuse tools at their default reasoning effort; the assistant now asks once more without reasoning.
- The assistant on Claude Sonnet 5.5 said it came back without an answer. Once it has asked for the answer, it now asks for it as plain text.
